onePageSummary: ‘Vocation’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects different kinds of work, respect for workers, childhood imagination, daily occupations, dignity of labour. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
quickChecks: Define or explain different kinds of work.

Define or explain dignity of labour.
Define or explain observation of people around us.
Define or explain expressing a personal view.
Define or explain sequence and inference.
Define or explain character/voice or poetic image.
Define or explain word meaning in context.
